name: Purdue Hackers µgrants
benefit: Funding for ambitious software, hardware, art or other student projects.
eligibility: Student project at Purdue.

name: Purdue Hackers Hack Night
benefit: Weekly open building night, workshops and project checkpoints.
eligibility: Any Purdue student, including beginners.

name: Moonshot Pitch Challenge
benefit: Two-minute idea pitch and live finals across three idea categories.
eligibility: Active Purdue undergraduate or graduate student, any college.

name: Firestarter
benefit: Seven-week cohort for business model, customer validation and pitch feedback.
eligibility: Purdue student, faculty, staff or alum with an idea to start within 3–9 months.

name: Market Readiness
audience: Purdue-connected startups with a team or prototype
benefit: Customer discovery, financial projections, executive summary and pitch deck.
eligibility: Purdue student, faculty, staff or alum; existing team or MVP is a fit.

name: New Venture Challenge
benefit: Workshops, investor pitch and cash prize competition.
eligibility: Current Purdue student startup team; a team and prototype are useful preparation.

name: Summer Sprint
benefit: Seven-week validation sprint with customer interviews and pitch materials.
eligibility: Purdue student, alum, faculty or staff.

name: Purdue Innovates Accelerator
benefit: Three-month investment-based accelerator with strategy, go-to-market and mentor support.
eligibility: Purdue-connected founder with an early-stage venture; see current cohort criteria.

name: Trask Innovation Fund
benefit: Short-term commercialization projects for formally disclosed Purdue IP.
eligibility: Purdue researchers, faculty or staff at any campus with disclosed Purdue technology.

name: Commercialization Fellowship
benefit: One-year full-time Postdoctoral Entrepreneur position to develop Purdue IP toward startup or license.
eligibility: Graduating PhD student or postdoc advancing disclosed Purdue IP with commercialization engagement.

name: Purdue OTC Invention Disclosure
benefit: Submit Purdue intellectual property for commercialization and protection review.
eligibility: Purdue IP arising through employment or enrollment; consult OTC before public disclosure.

name: Ag-Celerator Fund
benefit: Investment pool supporting commercialization of technologies benefiting agriculture.
eligibility: Purdue-connected startup (founder or C-suite Purdue affiliate, or Purdue IP license) with proof of concept and traction.

name: Black and Gold Fund
benefit: Pre-seed or seed capital for startups in Purdue strategic innovation areas.
eligibility: Purdue-connected startup (founder or C-suite Purdue affiliate, or Purdue IP license) with proof of concept and traction.

name: Foundry Investment Fund
benefit: Investment pool for Purdue-connected human, plant and animal health startups.
eligibility: Purdue-connected startup (founder or C-suite Purdue affiliate, or Purdue IP license) with proof of concept and traction.

name: Purdue Startup Fund
benefit: Capital for Purdue-connected startups aligned with university strategic innovation areas.
eligibility: Purdue-connected startup (founder or C-suite Purdue affiliate, or Purdue IP license) with proof of concept and traction.

name: Purdue HIVE
audience: Student founders building tech or engineering startups
benefit: Dedicated founder workspace, mentor network and connections to Purdue programs.
eligibility: Purdue student actively building and advancing a tech or engineering venture.

name: Venture X
benefit: Course sequence to discover problems, validate concepts and build startup teams.
eligibility: Purdue student; full benefits available to Honors students or teams with one Honors student and eligible engineering certificate students.
amount_text: Up to $5,000 per team for product and customer development

name: Certificate in Entrepreneurship and Innovation
benefit: Five-course certificate covering venture evaluation, models and applied entrepreneurship.
eligibility: Purdue undergraduate; review current completion requirements with advisor.

name: Burton D. Morgan Venture Concept Competition
benefit: Customer discovery, workshops, office hours and prize competition.
eligibility: Purdue student; concept must meet published limits on prior funding and revenue and exclude Purdue-owned IP.

name: BoilerLaunch
benefit: Investor-judged pitch event with workshops, feedback and cash prizes.
eligibility: Founder team; next application rules published by organizer.

name: The Forge
benefit: Founder, operator and investor conversations with live Q&A.
eligibility: Open to Purdue students.

name: Anvil Founder Community
benefit: Community nights, collaborators, peer feedback and ecosystem navigation.
eligibility: Purdue student; no startup or application required.

name: Anvil Founder Mentorship
benefit: Request pairing with Purdue alumni, local founders or Midwest investors.
eligibility: Purdue student founder; email startup and specific need.

name: Anvil Founder Workshops
audience: Student founders working on fundraising, product or go-to-market
benefit: Practitioner-led workshops and pitch feedback through academic year.
eligibility: Open to Purdue students; check events for each session.

name: Anvil Startup Roundtable Career Fair
benefit: Meet Purdue students for internships, co-ops and founding-team roles.
eligibility: Startup with at least one open role; organizer reviews registrations.

name: Purdue I-Corps Discovery
organizer: NSF I-Corps Great Lakes Hub / Purdue
benefit: Free customer discovery course with interviews and commercialization coaching.
eligibility: Midwest innovator or researcher with a deep tech innovation idea or IP.

name: Convergence Center for Innovation and Collaboration
audience: Startups seeking space and ecosystem access
benefit: Office and collaboration space alongside founders and Purdue innovators.
eligibility: Contact Purdue Research Foundation for space availability and terms.

name: buildpurdue Cohort
benefit: Semester cohort with weekly build sessions, accountability, expert connections and VC network introductions.
eligibility: Current Purdue student; individuals or teams up to four members may apply.

name: buildpurdue Nightshift
benefit: Open weekly work session to build, get feedback and meet other founders.
eligibility: Any Purdue student; no application or membership required.

name: Bechtel Innovation Design Center
benefit: Access advanced prototyping tools and project support through Purdue maker space.
eligibility: Purdue student; follow center project workflow and safety rules.
